name: Kohaku
source:
She is the leader of a tribe of foxes who came from far to the east and now have a country of their own. She is also the head of a secret spy organization called "kunoichi". Normally, she exudes an air of mystery that makes it difficult to tell her true nature.

In reality, she is a compassionate woman, willing to make any sacrifice for the sake of the one she loves. She has a younger brother named Menou, who is currently a prisoner in the service state.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1014490]Getchu[/url]]
